reviews.title: Lost ALL of my collections
reviews.text: I have been a paying subscriber to Bookly for several years now, and have enjoyed the app for the most part. A couple of months ago, the ability to scan the ISBN to add a new book stopped working, which was frustrating as that was one of the features I enjoyed the most. Yesterday, I noticed that every single one of the “collections” that I had created to track (all signed books, all publisher gifts, all books given to me by authors, etc.) had completely vanished. Gone. But that’s not all. Every single genre tag that I had created (MM Romance, Spicy, etc.) was also gone - like they had never existed. The basis of this app is to catalog your book collection; to organize your TBR and track all of your physical books, while also tracking progress on books you are currently reading. The thought of having to completely start from scratch and go through all 500 of my books to recategorize them makes me literally sick to my stomach. I’ve been paying monthly for a service that I am going to have to go back to square one. Frustrated doesn’t begin to explain where I am at right now.
